reason: The lab report behind the QR code and the empty-box refund make a $24.99 first box an easy try, and I already take something in the evening after the gym anyway. If a creator showed it fixing my bad sleep I'd tap the yellow cart.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? And 'made in China' makes me want to check that lab report is real.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing the real lab report and explaining why bisglycinate alone is enough would keep me in; if the report wasn't actually there I'd pass.
